text:
maya: Quick ping — PR #17902 is green everywhere except Windows smoke where a screenshot snapshot test is failing intermittently. Need one more approval before the merge window. anyone around to help triage? cc @raj
raj: On it. which test is failing?
maya: tests/ui/screenshot/layout_spec.py::test_toolbar_collisions — small pixel diff, looks like ~2px vertical offset. Repro only on windows-2022 pool so far.
taylor: I hit something similar last week. Often font fallback or display scaling on the VM causes 1–3px shifts. Did you try running locally with the same scale flags or --update-snapshots?
maya: Not yet — trying to avoid committing noisy goldens. Build log from CI below.
ci-bot: Build 17902.5: windows-2022-screenshot failed. 1 image differs. To retry: run `ci retry 17902/windows-screenshot` or use the rerun button.
raj: I'll trigger a targeted rerun now.
raj: /rerun windows-screenshot — kicked off. ETA ~10m.
maya: thanks 🙏 if it flakes again, can someone OK updating the golden? I can isolate render diff and add a tolerance if it's stable.
sara: If it's nondeterministic we should prefer rerun + root cause before changing goldens. Also there's one approval pending — @taylor can you give a quick UX check?
taylor: Quick eyeball: a 2px shift won't break layout, but prefer adding explicit device-scale=1 in the test env. That fixed the other instance I saw.
maya: Good call. I'll add the scale flag and re-run locally; if that makes it deterministic I'll push a tiny test update.
raj: Rerun passed — Build 17902.6 shows all green on windows. Tests OK. Approvals still required to merge.
taylor: LGTM from me, approving now.
maya: Thanks @taylor. @sara can you approve so we can merge during today's window?
sara: Approved. :shipit:
maya: Merging now. Follow-up: I'll open a small PR to add the explicit scale flag to the screenshot harness to avoid future flakiness.
